items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Just a thing I whipped up, you know [scats] but the dotted eighths and sixteenths that Lunceford used to play.

ctx.x: Yeah. Just a thing I whipped up, you know [scats] but the dotted eighths and sixteenths that Lunceford used to play. And he broke it in at Evichen’s Garden up in Denver. And for the first time in his history, the audience gathered around the bandstand and clapped at the end of the thing instead of just dancing around like they usually did. And his statement to me, he said, “I don’t understand the music,” but he said, “write some more like that.”
Oh, that’s great. It almost sounds like a little movie scene.
